  low: number

  volume?: number | undefined
type StudyComputeResult = (null | number)[] | { series: StudySeries[]; }
interface StudyDefinition
  aliases?: string[] | undefined
  compute: (bars: Bar[], inputs: StudyInputs) => StudyComputeResult
  defaults?: undefined | { [key: string]: number | string | undefined; length?: number | undefined; color?: string | undefined; }

  keywords?: string[] | undefined
  label?: string | undefined
  levels?: StudyPaneLevel[] | undefined
  name: string
  pane: 'overlay' | 'pane'
  range?: undefined | { min: number; max: number; }
interface StudyInputs
  [key: string]: number | string
  length: number
interface StudyPaneLevel
  axisLabel?: boolean | undefined
  dashed?: boolean | undefined
  value: number
class StudyRegistry

interface StudySeries

  name?: string | undefined
  style?: StudySeriesStyle | undefined
  values: (null | number)[]
type StudySeriesStyle = 'band' | 'histogram' | 'line'
